title: Replicating Refusal-Direction Ablation as a Jailbreak Across Prompt Categories

original_idea.body:
# Replicating Refusal-Direction Ablation as a Jailbreak Across Prompt Categories

**Problem:** The per-category effectiveness of single-direction refusal ablation is rarely broken out.

**Direction:** Reproduce single-direction refusal ablation, then evaluate compliance separately across harmful-prompt categories. Measure whether the single direction equally unlocks all categories or some retain refusal.

**Why it matters:** Whether refusal is one direction or several has direct implications for both defense and attack-surface understanding.

**Relevant context:** Arditi et al. 2024; StrongREJECT/AdvBench categorized prompts.
